completion_criteria: All retained #2909 policies have a documented class, applicability, effect, source revision, evidence/check owner, and exact detail route; guidelines remain advisory.

The reopened lifecycle selector and selected-proof regressions use the shared typed-result exit convention: invalid selection is rejected before lifecycle construction, effectful failure reports retry/mutation posture, and typed/process/session statuses agree while successful and dry-run results remain zero.
Selectors are validated before expensive payload construction and mutation, with one bounded correction/inventory route.

Maintained repo-local fixtures cover selected Planning absolute/scaling budgets, invalid-selector time/output, selected-proof zero residue/current reuse, and existing authoritative output-profile budgets; unstable duplicate narrow-proof latency policy is explicitly deferred rather than fabricated.

Deterministic invariant, measurable requirement, guideline, scoped Markdown reference, independent specialized owner, stale/failed/unknown/unavailable evidence, and direct/no-signal proportionality all compile through the one operating decision.
#2817 policy is preserved without claiming its dispatch-dependent acceptance complete; #2821-#2827 remain unchanged.
